name: Paratha
description: A flaky, layered flatbread served with curry or yogurt.
instructions: Knead flour with ghee, water, and salt into a soft dough.
Roll into flatbreads, cook on a tawa with ghee until golden.
Serve hot with achar or curry.

name: Halwa Puri
description: A traditional breakfast of semolina halwa with fried bread.
instructions: Roast semolina in ghee, add sugar and water to make halwa.
Knead flour into dough, roll into puris, and fry in oil.
Serve halwa with puris.

name: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Mash potatoes with spices, knead flour into dough.
Stuff potato mix into dough, roll and cook with ghee.
Serve with yogurt or pickle.

name: Naan Khatai
description: Sweet, crumbly biscuits paired with tea.
instructions: Mix ghee, sugar, and flour, add cardamom.
Shape into cookies, press almonds on top, bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes.
Serve with tea.

name: Chana Chaat
description: Spicy chickpea snack for a hearty breakfast.
instructions: Mix boiled chickpeas with chopped tomato and onion.
Add chaat masala and lemon juice, serve fresh.

name: Omelette with Paratha
description: A simple egg omelette served with paratha.
instructions: Beat eggs with chopped onion and chili, cook into an omelette.
Prepare paratha with flour and ghee.
Serve together.

name: Samosa
description: Crispy pastry filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions: Knead flour into dough, boil and mash potatoes with spices.
Fill dough with potato mix, fry until golden.
Serve with chutney.

name: Lassi
description: A refreshing yogurt drink to start the day.
instructions: Blend yogurt, sugar, and water until smooth.
Add ice cubes, serve chilled.

name: Puri Bhaji
description: Fried bread with a spicy potato curry.
instructions: Knead flour, fry as puris.
Cook mashed potatoes with mustard seeds and spices.
Serve puris with bhaji.

name: Anda Bhurji
description: Scrambled eggs with spices, a quick breakfast.
instructions: Sauté onion and tomato, add beaten eggs with turmeric.
Cook until scrambled, serve with bread or paratha.
